defects.description: The complete physical-constants table on problems p.1, explicitly available to all four problems, is absent from every problem statement. It supplies the printed numerical precision of g, gamma, particle masses, e, k_C, epsilon_0, mu_0, c, h, hbar, u, R, N_A, k_B and R_H. Gold repeats the table as shared data on each problem page.
Враца is transcribed as Брана, and the ministry masthead line is missing.
Printed Враца becomes Брана.
80 is invented; no paper total is printed.
All four problem totals (15,20,20,25) are invented; no per-problem total is printed.
Гюлетласкач becomes Гюлелтаскач; statement also changes гюле to голе.
The complete small-angle and binomial-approximation hint printed after part в) is absent.
Parts б)/в) use theta_i instead of theta_1 and contain corrupted words, including преметнете and градусин.

The zero on the left of the trajectory condition is theta; equation (5) loses v0² from its last numerator; equation (6) loses the minus branch of ±. Numerous prose lines receive invented 1.0-point awards. These alter the printed derivation.
The four-plate physical setup, equal areas S and spacing d, and conductor joining outer plates are absent from the statements.
Printed A/B/V/G hierarchy is confused; a solution paragraph on induced charges is invented as another В.а) problem part, with duplicate unscoped labels.
Body text has дълго for дъното, условно for успоредно, Утраскулени for Ултрастудени and other corruption.
Only section A is supplied: official solutions to Б (water force), В (potential and capacitance) and Г (neutron quantum well) are missing. The alternative Newton equation also loses its mass factor.
Unlabelled photodissociation background becomes a second в) part instead of shared problem data.
съответните им is corrupted to съответстват им.
The complete reduced-Planck-constant hint on problems p.4 is absent.
Equations (3) for ionization energy and (13) for orbit radii, including their awards, are absent.
Reduced Planck constant hbar is repeatedly transcribed as h in quantization, radii and energy formulas, changing their physical values.
Additional awards are invented at equations (11), (14), (15), which have no such awards in the source.
The source reference to equation (4) is silently corrected to (8); verbatim source errors must remain. The Balmer table lacks its Markdown separator row.
The optical-power question’s 1.0 point is lost; printed б) contains 1.5 plus 1.0.
Printed е) has 1.0 and 2.5 awards; the first is lost.
The full p.5 continuation asking for F after each Porro prism is absent.
The final numerical request with n=1.50 and lambda=580 nm is absent; the preceding interference conditions are heavily garbled.
The б), в), д) solutions are reordered and beam-diameter text is duplicated.
In е), x=s′−f_ok replaces x=s′−f_ob and the signs of the ocular lens equation (5) are altered.
The coating-reflection intensity derivation I1, I2, equality and n′=sqrt(n) is truncated; n′ becomes pi′ in the optical-path formula.
The Porro-prism statement drawing on problems p.5 is missing.
The second telescope diagram, showing alpha/beta angles on solutions p.9, is missing.

summary: All three candidates fail the verbatim/source-complete contract on this paper. Sonnet is the closest base, but omits the shared constants table and equation numbers and has multiple damaged crops; Haiku loses substantial statements/solutions and corrupts formulas, while GLM uses placeholders, corrupts a reaction and answer, and misses or mislocates figures. All 29 checker findings were adjudicated (26 true positives, 3 false positives); printed source errors are retained with notes, and no unresolved source glyph needs escalation.
notes: All 15 source pages, all 3 sanitized candidate views and all 35 supplied actual crops were read. No older Opus reference was supplied or used. The API checker top-level candidateSha mismatch is a known harness defect: the prompt had not supplied the hash, while nested checker.candidateSha256 was stamped by the harness. It is not counted as evidence of checking another paper. The selected raw Sonnet candidate lacks tx.reader; gold records that fact rather than inventing it.
